text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
I hear some folks roll numbered pencils 
during tests to pick answers... If you ask 
me, that's utter nonsense.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
What's the point of leaving it all to 
fate? It ain't a real gamble unless you're 
pressing the attack with your own will.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
If it were me, I'd bet the farm on what's 
gonna be on the test! I wouldn't even look 
at the rest!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
I don't waste time thinking about what 
happens if my bet misses. It's no fun 
without the risk, right?
